coverageNotes: SCOPE. Twenty critic-named gaps; none was already in the dataset under any name or alias (checked against every raw file). Placed: 15 companies with 18 offices. Left out: 5 companies. METHOD. Web search was used until the shared search budget ran out; after that the work used direct fetches of company pages and the GLEIF LEI registry API (legal and headquarters addresses of each Indian subsidiary, with last-update dates). Pins come from OSM building or park polygons in the shared extracts; there were no OSM office POIs for any of the 20 names. Live Overpass mirrors were down. LEFT OUT (could not be placed in Bengaluru with a substantiated building, so no pin was invented): (1) Woodside Energy (Woodside Global Solutions): its Bengaluru office is real (Woodside news story and Business Wire India, Sept 2026), but no building or locality is published and no Indian LEI entity was found. (2) Airbnb: the only Indian GCC entity, Airbnb Global Capability Center Pvt Ltd, is registered at 241 Udyog Vihar Phase-1, Gurugram (GLEIF 984500740823COEA8E06), Airbnb's careers site lists no India roles, and no Bengaluru office could be substantiated; the 'Bengaluru engineering centre' claim looks wrong. (3) Kimberly-Clark: its Indian entities are in Pune (Sanaswadi plant; Chakan) and Mumbai. A second critic's hint of a 'Global Digital Technology Centre, Infantry Road' could not be confirmed. (4) STMicroelectronics: Wikipedia describes a Bangalore HW/SW design centre of 250+ people, but no address was found; st.com returned 503 and the only Indian LEI entity is Delhi/Greater Noida. (5) Panasonic (Panasonic India Innovation Centre): no Bengaluru entity or address was found among Panasonic's Indian LEI records (all in Gurugram, Delhi, Chennai, Vadodara and Pune), and panasonic.com returned 403. WEAK OR UNCERTAIN PLACEMENTS. Mastercard (low): Bengaluru is confirmed as one of its Indian offices, but the Brigade Gateway 6th-floor address is from a single blog. Zoom (low): the city is confirmed by zoom.com, but Embassy TechVillage Block L is from a single Glassdoor listing. FIS (medium): the address is from FIS's own 2021 ISO certificate appendix and a Justdial listing and may be dated; a third-party profile also mentioned RMZ Ecoworld, which is unconfirmed. Ralph Lauren (medium): the LEI-registered Sourcing LLP in Brigade Tech Gardens SEZ is placed, but the new GCC's building is unpublished; an older liaison and RL Sourcing office at Prestige Nebula, Cubbon Road, was not added because its current status is unknown. Twilio (medium): this is the CoWrks floor in the registry; Twilio India Pvt Ltd's registered office at a Langford Road residential complex was not added because it is not an operating office. Magna (medium): the pin is at locality level (Hoodi). HubSpot: the registry's Electronics City address is a residential registered office; the operating office is the official WeWork Cherry Hills address. H&M: the older WTC Bengaluru 11th-floor address (Zauba) appears superseded by Phoenix Asia Towers in the 2026 LEI record, so it was not added. Kenvue: a GST record (seen only in search results) gives Redwood D3, 7th floor, in the same park; the Acacia LEI address was used. Two Manyata pins use the Acacia polygon way/1136507017, assumed to be the Parcel 2 (M3) block because ANZ's 'Acacia Parcel 1' maps to way/1073961646. isHq marks the company's India head or registered office where that is in Bengaluru. HEADCOUNTS: only UST (6,500+, April 2025) and Albertsons (about 300) are given; all others are null rather than guessed.
